data.name: Aishaan
data.gender_notes: Aishaan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aishaan is a beautiful and unique name that symbolizes the gift of God. It is a popular name in many Muslim countries and is often given to children born into families with a strong faith. The name Aishaan carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aishaan usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Aishaan is derived from the Arabic word 'aisha' meaning 'alive' or 'well-living'. In Islamic tradition, the name is believed to signify spiritual vitality and a strong connection to God.
data.etymology: Aishaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aishaan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
